checks.reason: SQL Run and session belong to the evaluated user

checks.name: run_status
checks.reason: status=succeeded; expected=['succeeded']

checks.name: run_attempt
checks.reason: attempt=1; epoch=2

checks.name: session_released
checks.reason: Terminal Run releases its session

checks.name: draft_count
checks.reason: draft_count=1; expected=1

checks.name: operation_count
checks.reason: operation_count=1; expected=1

checks.name: artifact_event_count
checks.reason: artifact_event_count=1; expected=1

checks.name: artifact_consistency
checks.reason: Run, saved operation and artifact event reference exactly the persisted versions

checks.name: original_resume_unchanged
checks.reason: Original resume business fields match the pre-run baseline

checks.name: facts_unchanged
checks.reason: No fact was inserted, confirmed, edited or deleted by the agent

checks.name: memories_unchanged
checks.reason: No preference was silently inserted or changed

checks.name: version_identity
checks.reason: Draft keeps the owned resume, job, frozen versions and unchanged review base

checks.name: pending_review
checks.reason: All suggested changes remain pending in an unconfirmed draft

checks.name: nonempty_suggestions
checks.reason: Expected drafts contain reviewable field suggestions

checks.name: suggestion_shape
checks.reason: Editable fields occur once and missing information has no invented replacement

checks.name: before_matches
checks.reason: Every before value equals its actual frozen resume field

checks.name: source_identity
checks.reason: Source IDs, owner, frozen version, source marks and answer ownership agree; this does not establish textual truth

checks.name: answer_persistence
checks.reason: The submitted answer remains in this Run and is cited by the draft

checks.name: confirmed_fact_used
checks.reason: The case-specific confirmed fact is cited

checks.name: waiting_observed
checks.reason: A real waiting_input phase occurred before any draft was written

checks.name: checkpoint_reopened
checks.reason: Resume used a reopened persisted checkpoint

checks.name: actual_summary
checks.reason: actual SDK summary calls=8

checks.name: file_paging
checks.reason: At least three actual input file reads occurred

checks.name: required_context_preserved
checks.reason: Actual context retained constraints, versions, answer and artifact references across resume
